title: Survival, providence and public allegiance
scope: Selected source dossier, not a representative history of all audiences or a score of supernatural identity. Existing ranking inputs are unchanged. Reading scopes below describe this research pass, not an independent authentication of every statement in a source.

sources.title: Trump's nomination address, July 18, 2024
sources.access: Read the opening survival account, bracketed audience responses, memorial and mission language in the American Presidency Project transcript. Raw footage and medical assertions were not independently checked.
sources.locator: Opening account through the paragraphs following the memorial

sources.title: Franklin Graham Prays at Republican Convention
sources.access: Full BGEA article read, including prayer for other victims and leaders of different parties. Event is the closing convention night, July 18; the page is dated July 19. Not a separately collated full video transcript.
sources.locator: Remarks and prayer reproduced in the article

sources.title: The Inaugural Address
sources.access: Read the survival-to-mission passage and surrounding remarks in the White House transcript. This records the public claim, not divine authorization or acceptance by every listener.
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning Just a few months ago; subsequent applause notes

sources.title: Reuters/Ipsos post-attempt poll: topline and methodology
sources.access: Summary table on printed page 12 visually inspected. Item detail on page 13 and methodology on page 23 read from parsed text; screenshots of those latter pages failed. No respondent microdata or joint-response table reviewed.
sources.locator: Printed pages 12-13, TM3247Y24_1 and _2; page 23 methodology

sources.title: The race remains unchanged after the assassination attempt
sources.access: Full release and methodology read. The narrative mentions fielding around the running-mate announcement; the formal methodology dates the poll July 16. Preserve that wording rather than inventing a new field period.
sources.locator: Detailed findings and About the Study

sources.title: Most say Trump should follow the same rules as other presidents
sources.access: Findings and methodology read: fielded November 22-24, 2024, 1,029 US adults; whole-sample margin plus or minus 3.3 points, Republicans plus or minus 5.9. Not linked respondent-by-respondent to the July poll.
sources.locator: Detailed findings 1 and About the Study

sources.title: Vice President's statement after Reagan was shot
sources.kind: Official historical statement and editorial note
sources.access: Reagan Library text and note read. The note reports the hospital briefing on a bullet penetrating Reagan's left lung, surgery, stable condition and a favorable prognosis. It is not an original hospital chart.
sources.locator: Note describing Dr. Dennis O'Leary's briefing

sources.title: Reagan diary page labeled March 30, 1981
sources.access: Full transcribed entry read. Although headed March 30, its text continues through April 11. Composition date and original manuscript were not independently established. Do not date every sentence March 30.
sources.locator: Prayer for the attacker and concluding return-home passage

sources.title: Reagan's return to Congress, April 28, 1981
sources.access: Opening and transition to the economic argument read: acknowledgment of the greeting, public prayers and other injured people; later acknowledgment of improved health through care. No applause duration or audience proportions independently measured.
sources.locator: Opening paragraphs before the economic program

sources.title: Revelation 13, World English Bible
sources.access: Read the full translated chapter, especially 3-4 and 12-15. Appearance, healing, marveling, worship and enforcement remain distinct parts of the narrative.

sources.title: Luke 13, World English Bible
sources.access: Read 13:1-5 in the chapter: victims of Pilate and the falling tower are not declared worse sinners. Application to modern survival narratives is this study's interpretation.

sources.title: Quran 5:8, The Clear Quran
sources.kind: Primary text in Mustafa Khattab's translation
sources.access: Verse and displayed surrounding context read. Just testimony despite hostility supplies an ethical comparison, not an identification of Islamic and Christian eschatological figures.

records.title: What the survivor said the crowd believed
records.observation: Trump described spectators first believing he was dead, then recognizing survival when he raised his fist.
records.contribution: This directly documents a public interpretation of apparent death and renewed presence, relevant to the proposed wound-and-reception comparison.
records.countercase: His statement about most spectators' beliefs is not an independent audience measurement. It cannot establish their medical judgment or instantaneous healing.
records.next: Compare original continuous footage with separately dated witness testimony, retaining each audience's location and exposure.

records.title: A response is recorded, but not a global consensus
records.observation: The transcript includes the audience's reply, Yes, you are, when Trump says he was not supposed to be there, and a later supportive chant.
records.contribution: The source records reciprocal affirmation, not only a leader speaking about himself.
records.countercase: A party convention is a selected audience. This and the speaker account are two observations from one source, not two independent witnesses.
records.next: Separate appreciation, political support, divine attribution and worship in audience coding.

records.title: Religious legitimation with an internal qualification
records.observation: Graham attributed survival to God while acknowledging he could not explain why another life was lost; he also prayed across party lines.
records.contribution: An identifiable religious intermediary helped articulate the event's meaning. This is stronger evidence than attributing one interpretation to all religious people.
records.countercase: The qualification and care for other victims complicate equating the whole prayer with personal worship or unconditional political obedience.
records.next: Compare a religious speaker's words with the subsequent obligations and limits they place on the leader.

records.title: Survival is publicly linked to a political purpose
records.observation: The inaugural address explicitly connects survival with being saved by God to make America great again; the transcript notes applause.
records.contribution: The proposed move from survival to a particular mission has a direct textual example.
records.countercase: A declared purpose is not proof of divine authorization, achieved repair, universal assent or immunity from criticism.
records.next: Test whether subsequent decisions remain answerable to the values invoked by the mission claim.

records.title: Religious attribution has measurable, uneven reach
records.observation: The retrieved topline reports 33% overall and 66% of Republicans agreeing with its divine-providence or God's-will item.
records.contribution: This establishes a sampled public belief, beyond selected convention remarks.
records.countercase: It asks neither whether Trump is divine nor whether he should be obeyed unconditionally. The current PDF is the cited edition, not a certified original-day snapshot.
records.next: Recover original release versions and examine differing published subgroup figures before asserting an exact historical revision.

records.title: Luck and providence are not exclusive response categories
records.observation: A separate item reports 78% overall and 91% of Republicans agreeing that survival was very lucky.
records.contribution: Different interpretations of the event can coexist in the same survey population.
records.countercase: The two question totals must not be added. Without joint-response data, neither their exact overlap nor individual conversions can be calculated.
records.next: Use a joint-response table or respondent data before claiming how particular beliefs travel together.

records.title: Reception is not automatically electoral conversion
records.observation: The publisher describes the registered-voter contest as statistically tied after the attack.
records.contribution: This is a contemporaneous constraint on treating vivid reception as demonstrated mass transfer of political allegiance.
records.countercase: A cross-sectional result is not an experiment proving no effect, and the release does not measure world opinion.
records.next: Use comparable repeated measures and distinguish prior support from genuinely changed preference.

records.title: Expressed support for ordinary checks remains visible
records.observation: The later survey reports 88% overall and 82% of Republicans favoring the same rules and outside checks as for other presidents.
records.contribution: Automatic acceptance of unchecked authority is not supported merely by the earlier providence response.
records.countercase: Different dates, questions and respondents prevent an individual-level inference. Stated support for checks also does not demonstrate actual institutional behavior.
records.next: Compare these stated principles with subsequent specific decisions without merging the two surveys into one cohort.

records.title: An earlier survivor received medical treatment
records.observation: The archived note reports a bullet wound to Reagan's left lung, surgery, stable condition and a favorable prognosis.
records.contribution: A prior presidential case permits comparison of injury, treatment, survival and later representation.
records.countercase: A medically treated injury is not proof of resurrection, supernatural enhancement or identical wounds in the two cases.
records.next: Retain the medical timeline separately from later rhetorical descriptions.

records.title: The diary links dependence on God to prayer for an attacker
records.observation: The transcribed account describes relinquishing hatred while praying for the attacker, and later expresses an obligation to serve God.
records.contribution: A survival interpretation can articulate moral obligation rather than only personal exceptionalism, a concrete comparison for inward formation.
records.countercase: This is self-reported reflection, not an audit of later conduct. The page's March 30 label cannot date its April 11 passage or establish the writing date.
records.next: Compare the stated orientation with subsequent conduct rather than awarding whole-life moral status from a diary entry.

records.title: Public return joins gratitude, other victims and policy advocacy
records.observation: Reagan acknowledged his greeting and public prayers, praised others injured and medical care, then argued for his economic program.
records.contribution: Survival, grateful return and renewed political advocacy occurred in a prior case, so those features alone cannot identify a unique modern fulfillment.
records.countercase: The transcript does not quantify world admiration, record every listener's motives or establish that gratitude caused policy assent.
records.next: Compare the same questions across both figures, without inferring identical character or historical consequences.

records.title: Survival must not become a verdict against those who died
records.observation: Luke's passage rejects declaring the people killed by Pilate or by the falling tower worse sinners than others.
records.contribution: The proposed repair reading refuses to make an asymmetric outcome a simple scale of personal worth.
records.countercase: The passage also calls for repentance. It is not a survey or a complete philosophical explanation of suffering.
records.next: Keep the harmed people and their continuing needs visible in any survival-and-providence narrative.

records.title: The critic's testimony is also answerable to justice
records.observation: Quran 5:8 requires just testimony and refuses hostility toward a people as a justification for injustice.
records.contribution: This supplies a specific interfaith connection: the evaluator cannot exempt their own pattern matching from the ethical test.
records.countercase: Shared ethical structure does not make different traditions' prophetic offices or doctrines interchangeable.
records.next: Apply the same sourcing and counterevidence requirements to political allies and opponents.

survey.method: Probability-based KnowledgePanel; weighted results, rounded percentages.

items.label: Survival attributed to divine providence or God's will

survey.constraint: Separate agreement items, not competing options. Do not add them, compute exact respondent overlap, infer causation or call these world-opinion estimates. Published source variants are not silently reconciled.

tasks.work: Recover direct survivor and intermediary statements
tasks.done: Convention, inaugural, Graham and Reagan texts read at the declared scopes; original audiovisual collation remains open.
Two survey items and their sample definition recorded; a separate accountability survey is not treated as the same cohort.
Recover continuous original footage and separate contemporaneous testimony; record timecodes, edits, location and prior affiliation.
Recover original poll releases and dates, and determine why some reports use a different Republican percentage; preserve versions until resolved.
Separate attention, gratitude, providence, mission, changed allegiance and permission to evade judgment; no stage is imputed from another.
Use these sources in versioned assessments under a declared interpretation, with countercases and reviewer attribution; this intake changes no existing score.
